usedFor: Text-Em-All handles texting and Microsoft Excel keeps the log, so “New Text Received” can run “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Text Received” in Text-Em-All, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every incoming text becomes a row, so replies sit in one table the team can sort.

watchOut: “Broadcast Status Changes” fires on each status change, so “Add Row To Table” can add several rows for one broadcast.
